_notes: Era layer: what changes when a game is set in the Enterprise era (2151–2161). Applied after the base data when the game's setup names era 'ent' (GameData.Load(dir, new DataSetup(Era: "ent"))), before faction and scenario layers. An era layer sets orbit/era itself, so the transporter level (surfaces orbit transporter by_era: ent = 1, the early transporter) follows. Earth's NX-class and a Klingon Raptor are the ships in orbit; ops: set (existing value), add_field, add_record (after), remove, list_add, list_remove; paths name records by id.
